CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY sales_report AS
  FUNCTION quarter_total(p_region IN VARCHAR2, p_fiscal_year IN NUMBER, p_quarter IN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
    l_view_quarter NUMBER;
    l_view_year    NUMBER;
    l_total        NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    -- Fiscal Q1 (Jul-Sep) -> Standard Q3
    -- Fiscal Q2 (Oct-Dec) -> Standard Q4
    -- Fiscal Q3 (Jan-Mar) -> Standard Q1 (Next Year)
    -- Fiscal Q4 (Apr-Jun) -> Standard Q2 (Next Year)
    
    l_view_quarter := CASE p_quarter
                        WHEN 1 THEN 3
                        WHEN 2 THEN 4
                        WHEN 3 THEN 1
                        WHEN 4 THEN 2
                      END;
                      
    l_view_year := CASE p_quarter
                     WHEN 1 THEN p_fiscal_year
                     WHEN 2 THEN p_fiscal_year
                     WHEN 3 THEN p_fiscal_year + 1
                     WHEN 4 THEN p_fiscal_year + 1
                   END;

    SELECT SUM(sales_amount)
    INTO l_total
    FROM quarterly_sales_v
    WHERE region = p_region
      AND fiscal_year = l_view_year
      AND fiscal_quarter = l_view_quarter;

    RETURN NVL(l_total, 0);
  END quarter_total;
END sales_report;
/
